body.message: The Address Opera unit we have is a 2BR, so no 1BR there at the moment. For City Walk, we've got a 2BR in Viridian Central Park at AED 10,500/month and two 2BR units in Buildings 2A and B22 at AED 12,000/month. Your dates are just over a week, so those would be priced as short-term stays rather than monthly. Want me to pull the nightly rates for City Walk?
